title: AI Tool Selection Radar
description: Three vendors on four criteria at once -- and a ranking that changes depending on which criterion your club puts first.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

educational.audience: Club leaders choosing an AI tool

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a radar comparison of three AI tool vendors scored against four selection criteria, the learner justifies which vendor best fits a stated club priority.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Toggle vendors on and off; choose a priority criterion and watch the ranked list re-sort
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which vendor a privacy-first club should pick, and to justify it against the other two.
